fields.Name: Yeon Si-eun
fields.Background: Yeon Si-eun is a high school student known for his exceptional intelligence and academic prowess. Despite being physically weaker and smaller than his peers, Si-eun has always relied on his brilliant mind to navigate the challenges of school life. He is a model student who consistently ranks at the top of his class, but his success comes at a cost—he's socially isolated and frequently targeted by bullies who see him as an easy mark. Si-eun's life takes a dramatic turn when he befriends Ahn Su-ho and Oh Beom-seok, forming an unlikely alliance. After experiencing brutal bullying, Si-eun realizes that intelligence alone isn't enough to survive, and he begins to learn how to fight back, both physically and strategically. His analytical mind allows him to study fighting techniques methodically, turning his weakness into a calculated strength.
fields.Strengths: Exceptional Intelligence: Si-eun possesses remarkable analytical and problem-solving abilities. He can quickly understand complex situations, devise strategies, and find creative solutions to problems that would stump others. Academic Excellence: His dedication to studying has made him one of the top students in his school, with deep knowledge across multiple subjects that he can apply practically. Strategic Thinking: Si-eun approaches conflicts like chess matches, analyzing opponents' patterns, weaknesses, and motivations to gain advantages despite physical disadvantages. Adaptability: When faced with the reality that intelligence alone won't protect him, Si-eun demonstrates remarkable ability to learn new skills, including martial arts and self-defense. Loyalty: Once Si-eun forms genuine friendships, he is deeply loyal and willing to put himself at risk to protect those he cares about. Observation Skills: He notices details others miss, allowing him to read situations and people effectively.
fields.Weaknesses: Physical Weakness: Si-eun lacks natural physical strength and athletic ability, making him vulnerable in direct physical confrontations, especially at the beginning of his journey. Social Isolation: His focus on academics and his introverted nature have left him with poor social skills and few friends, making him an easy target for bullies. Emotional Vulnerability: Despite his intellectual armor, Si-eun is emotionally fragile and deeply affected by betrayal, rejection, and violence. Overthinking: His analytical mind sometimes leads to paralysis by analysis, where he overcomplicates situations or hesitates when quick action is needed. Pride and Stubbornness: Si-eun's intelligence can make him overconfident in his assessments, and he sometimes refuses help or refuses to back down even when it would be wiser to do so. Trust Issues: His experiences with bullying and betrayal make it difficult for him to trust others, limiting his ability to form alliances or accept support.
